items.zh: 蚂蚁发布 Ling-3.2-flash：总参数 5600 亿，每步只算其中约 250 亿，上下文 100 万词元，能读文字、图和视频。
items.en: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-flash on 5 Nov 2026: 560 billion parameters in total, about 25 billion used on each step, a one-million-token context, and text, image and video input.

zh: 总参数 5600 亿、每步大约 250 亿，是来源里写的数：这一步没有把整张表都算一遍。
第 12 站的「每次只叫醒几个专家」说的就是这种安排：大部分参数这一步睡着。
它还能读图和视频。第 15a 站把图切成小块，和文字排进同一句话。
上下文写到 100 万词元。第 15b 站把「放得下」和「多想一会」分开：窗口变长，不等于中间每个字都被用上。
en: The source states 560 billion parameters in total and about 25 billion used on a step: that step does not touch the whole table.
Stop 12, “only a few experts wake up”, is that arrangement: most parameters sleep for the step.
It also reads images and video. Stop 15a cuts a picture into patches and lines them up with the words.
The context is listed as one million tokens. Stop 15b separates “it fits” from “it thinks longer”: a longer window is not the same as using every token in the middle.

items.zh: 腾讯发布 Hy4：这次加上了看图，以及在命令行和图形界面里办事。权重和系统卡写着随后公开。
items.en: Tencent announced Hy4 on 4 Nov 2026, adding image understanding and the ability to work in a terminal or a graphical interface. Weights and a system card were described as coming next.

zh: 来源写的是：这次加上看图，并能在命令行或图形界面里办事。权重和系统卡写着随后公开，页上还没有文件本身。
看图对应第 15a 站「一条边有几块」：图先切成小块，再和文字走同一套注意力。
在界面里办事对应第 14 站：模型只写下要调用什么，旁边的程序去执行。
第 A 站把同一套做法放进真实任务里看：会不会停下来问人。
en: The source says this release adds image understanding and work inside a terminal or a graphical interface. Weights and a system card were described as coming next; the page does not include the files yet.
Images line up with stop 15a, “how many patches along one edge”: cut the picture into patches, then use the same attention as the words.
Working in an interface lines up with stop 14: the model only writes the call, and a program next to it runs the call.
Stop A puts that same pattern into a real task and asks whether it stops for a person.

items.zh: vLLM 当天支持 Kimi K3.1 Pro：开源权重，总参数 2.8 万亿、每步约 1040 亿，上下文 100 万词元，并在全注意力层用了稀疏注意力。
items.en: On 4 Nov 2026 vLLM shipped day-0 support for Kimi K3.1 Pro: open weights, 2.8 trillion parameters with about 104 billion active, a one-million-token context, and sparse attention on the full-attention layers.

zh: 来源写的是当天就能在 vLLM 里跑：开源权重，总参数 2.8 万亿，每步大约 1040 亿，上下文 100 万词元。
「全注意力层用了稀疏注意力」对应第 8a 站「打分：谁和我对得上」：不是每个词都跟所有词打一遍分。
每步只算一部分参数，和第 12 站「每次只叫醒几个专家」是同一类安排。
100 万词元的窗口对应第 15b 站：放得下，和多想一会，是两件事。
en: The source says day-0 support in vLLM: open weights, 2.8 trillion parameters, about 104 billion active, and a one-million-token context.
Sparse attention on the full-attention layers lines up with stop 8a, “score: who matches me”: not every word is scored against every other word.
Using only part of the parameters on a step is the same kind of arrangement as stop 12, “only a few experts wake up”.
A one-million-token window lines up with stop 15b: fitting the text, and thinking longer, are two jobs.

items.zh: OpenAI 发布面向授权安全研究的模型，训练目标包括留在研究者划定的范围里。用它之前，先看安全那一站：不可信文本不是新指令，高风险动作要人确认。
items.en: On 5 Nov 2026 OpenAI announced a model for authorized security research, trained to stay inside the scope a researcher sets. Before using that kind of tool, read the safety stop: untrusted text is not a new instruction, and high-risk actions wait for a person.

zh: 来源写的是：这个模型面向授权的安全研究，训练目标包括留在研究者划定的范围里。
第 S 站「高风险的动作要等人」：付钱、删除、外发默认停下来问人。只读的查询可以自己做。
同一站把塞进来的纸条当成数据，不当成新指令。来源里的“留在范围内”说的是同一类边界。
第 14 站接着说：模型只写下调用，真正执行的是旁边的程序，所以程序这边才能拦住高风险动作。
en: The source says the model is for authorized security research, and that training includes staying inside a scope the researcher sets.
Stop S, “high-risk actions wait for a person”: paying, deleting and sending stop for a nod. A read-only lookup can run alone.
The same stop treats a slipped-in note as data, not as a new instruction. “Stay inside the scope” in the source is that kind of boundary.
Stop 14 continues: the model only writes the call, and a program runs it, so the program is where a high-risk action can be stopped.

items.zh: Flower 发布 Endeavor 1.1：可以看图，思维过程可以打开看，也可以把推理放在欧盟的机器上。
items.en: On 3 Nov 2026 Flower released Endeavor 1.1: image input, thinking traces you can open, and an option to run inference on machines in the EU.

zh: 来源写的是三件事：能看图，思维过程可以打开，推理可以放在欧盟的机器上。
思维过程可以打开，对应第 15b 站「投票看出现次数」：多想一会是采样和核对，不是把窗口偷偷加长。
看图对应第 15a 站：图切成小块，和文字走同一套注意力。
第 E 站提醒：犹豫少不等于答得对。打开思维过程，是为了核对，不是为了看它写得顺。
en: The source lists three things: image input, thinking traces you can open, and an option to run inference on machines in the EU.
Traces you can open line up with stop 15b, “a vote counts how often”: thinking longer is sampling and checking, not quietly growing the window.
Images line up with stop 15a: cut the picture into patches and use the same attention as the words.
Stop E adds: little hesitation is not the same as being right. Open the trace to check it, not to admire how smoothly it writes.
